public_rationale: Marcus's statement concerns public availability when he wrote it. OpenAI's April 4 roadmap still placed GPT-5 several months ahead. Its subsequent introduction was dated August 7. These records support the April observation; the later release does not turn it into a failed prediction.
limitations: The assessment concerns public release, not the existence of internal models or private testing.
The contemporaneous status announcement precedes the post by two days.
